old_caption: The video captures a serene and inviting scene centered around a steaming cup of coffee. The cup, a simple yet elegant white ceramic mug, sits prominently on a rustic burlap surface. Surrounding the mug is a generous pile of roasted coffee beans, their rich brown hues contrasting beautifully with the white of the mug and the earthy tones of the burlap. Steam rises gently from the cup, indicating that the coffee is freshly brewed and piping hot. The background is a deep, dark black, which serves to highlight the warm colors of the coffee beans and the steam. The overall atmosphere is one of warmth and comfort, evoking a sense of relaxation and enjoyment. There are no visible characters or animals in the scene, and the camera remains stationary throughout, focusing solely on the cup and its surroundings. The video emphasizes the sensory experience of the coffee, drawing the viewer's attention to the details of the steam, the texture of the burlap, and the inviting appearance of the coffee beans

caption: The video captures a white ceramic cup with its handle on the left, resting in a bed of roasted coffee beans spread across a folded tan burlap cloth against a uniform black background. A plume of pale, semi-transparent steam is already rising from the cup's rim when the excerpt opens and continues to ascend throughout. The column of vapor continuously morphs, its width, swirl pattern, and brightness shifting from frame to frame as wisps curl, thin, and reform while climbing. The vapor narrows and widens, its edges curling and dissipating as it climbs toward the top of the frame. The cup itself, the scattered beans, and the soft folds of the burlap remain fixed in position and appearance, showing no translation or deformation. The framing stays constant across the segment, with no detectable camera movement altering the composition. The steam thus forms the only visible motion, a slow, evolving drift already underway at the first frame and still ongoing at the last.
